note: The check suite runs ONLY checks registered here (founding spec §4).
Registration requires an admission record: the named defect the check
caught or the contract it uniquely carries, the licensing issue, and a
removal signal declared at birth. An unregistered check file is dead
code; one meta check asserts the registry and the checks/ tree agree.

admission.contract: registry/tree agreement, both ways (an unregistered check file is dead code, a registered file that does not exist is a dangling entry), plus admission-shape validation: every registered entry carries a non-empty admission record — the contracts this file's own note declares and nothing else carries
admission.removal_signal: a suite runner whose discovery is registry-driven, making an unregistered file unrunnable by construction — constrain-generation subsumes this detection

admission.contract: the consult-first discipline's reading act: reports the branch's consulted: receipt count and distinct pins, rendering zero explicitly — an obligation generates no event to hook, so observability is the whole remedy. Fails only on a malformed receipt, never on the count
admission.removal_signal: a gateway-side consumer receipt surface that reports served consultations back to the consumer — that would verify against the server's record rather than the consumer's claim, superseding this check's weaker evidence
